Four students designed and built air propelled rockets that were launched into the air. Their data are recorded in the table.

Data Table

| Rocket | Mass (kg) | Net Force (N) |
|-------|------------|---------------|
| 1     | 0.528      | 12.0          |
| 2     | 0.426      | 8.0           |
| 3     | 0.515      | 12.0          |
| 4     | 0.477      | 8.0           |

Which rocket had the greatest acceleration?
